entries.ea480f5a7d4e9d97: Its corporate philosophy reads: 'With great aspiration and boundless passion, we create the world's highest-level innovation and contribute to society.' The company is pursuing its 'Package Strategy', which comprehensively resolves issues across the various production processes involved in electronic device manufacturing, in growth fields. To enhance corporate value over the medium to long term, the company's basic policy is to shift its growth driver from the conventional FPD field to the semiconductor field, promote the transformation of its business portfolio, and concentrate management resources in the advanced packaging field, centred on semiconductors for AI. In March 2026, to strengthen its advanced packaging business, the company established a new organization, the 'Advanced Packaging Business Promotion Headquarters', to consolidate the group's organization.
